result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers merge the same items: the button variants, TextInput into TextField, and Tag/StatusPill into a Badge with a hedge. Both keep Chip, IconButton, the overlays and the loaders separate with reasons, and both split Card into a plain surface plus domain cards. A has sharper verify notes (LinkButton rendering an <a>, a 22→17 count) and a risk-first order. B gives a more concrete Card split (slots, 3–5 props, ProductCard and RefillCard may already wrap Card) and adds a kiosk touch-target check. Neither is clearly better. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers merge the same things, keep the same things separate and split Card the same way, so they are very close. B is slightly better: it adds specific checks you can't settle from a name list, such as whether LinkButton renders an <a> and whether SearchField and PasswordInput are built on the old TextInput. It also counts the imports a codemod would move and explicitly says to keep ProductCard and RefillCard separate.
